scripts.build:e2e: cargo build -p tauri-hasgard-cli && tauri build --debug --no-bundle --features hasgard-testing
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build:e2e && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:stress: bun run build:e2e && HASGARD_NATIVE_STRESS=1 playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts native-focus.spec.ts
